data_description.source_entity: For latching, the fastest-clearing motion entity works best (e.g. VALLHORN Motion, not Occupancy).
data_description.hold_time: How long occupancy stays on after motion, in seconds.
data_description.hold_mode: VALLHORN-style counts from the last motion. Use 'when motion clears' for presence sensors that stay on.
data_description.door_entity: Enables the latch: door closed + new motion after it closed = occupied until the door opens.
data_description.door_active: Most door sensors report on = open. Pick inverted if yours reports on = closed.
data_description.max_latch: Safety release for a stuck latch, in seconds. 0 disables.
